When Does the NFL Rio Game 2026 Start ?

The NFL Rio Game happens on Sunday (Sept. 27) with a matchup featuring the Baltimore Ravens (1-1) taking on the Dallas Cowboys (1-1) at Maracanã Stadium in Rio De Janeiro, Brazil, with a start time of 4:25 p.m. ET/1:25 p.m. PT.

What TV Network Features the NFL Rio Game 2026?

The Ravens-Cowboys game broadcasts on CBS , while the NFL game is available to livestream on Paramount+.

Which Celebrities Are Making Appearances During the NFL Rio Game 2026?

NFL games are known for celebrity sightings, so it’s likely there may be a number of famous actors, actresses and recording artists in attendance. Artists have been known to appear at games in the past, include Brazilian NFL fans, Anitta, Luísa Sonza, Neymar Jr. and others.

In addition, Pedro Sampaio and Ricky Martin are scheduled to perform during the halftime show. It starts around 5:45 p.m. ET/2:45 p.m. PT.
